payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jeanene, Layla, Mona, Pauline

payload.content:
Hi all (Jeanene, Layla, Mona). I'm Pauline. My skills are heavily mobile-development (0.61) and my private costs reflect that: ISSUE-0001 tasks are cheap for me (triage 2.25, review/docs 2.82, test 3.94, implement 5.63), while ISSUE-0002 (ui-ux-design/testing, critical) is very costly for me (review 40, test 56, implement 80).

Proposal: I take ONE low-priority mobile task so the critical ISSUE-0002 tasks can go to whoever has the best ui-ux-design/testing fit. I'm leaning toward ISSUE-0001::triage (cheapest for me) unless someone else wants it — I can flex to review/docs/test/implement on 0001.

Please reply with which task you intend to claim so we avoid duplicates. If any of you have strong ui-ux-design skill, please take the critical 0002 tasks (higher priority = more reward).

Hi all — I'm Mona. My top skill is testing (0.87), and my private costs strongly favor the critical ISSUE-0002 tasks: review=7.44, test=10.42, implement=15.89, versus ISSUE-0001 tasks which cost me 16–40. So my clear intent is to claim ONE of the three critical ISSUE-0002 tasks (prefer review or test).

There are 3 critical 0002 tasks (review/test/implement) and 5 low 0001 tasks. To maximize joint score we should put our best ui-ux-design/testing fits on 0002. Could Jeanene and Layla please share your skills and 0002 costs? If either of you is a stronger ui-ux-design fit than me, I'll flex to a different 0002 task or to a 0001 task.

Pauline: agreed, you take a low 0001 mobile task (triage is fine) — that keeps 0002 free for the rest of us.

Hi all — I'm Jeanene. Skills: testing 0.84, mobile-development 0.64. Availability 6.0h. My private 0002 costs: review=7.72, test=10.81, implement=17.44. Note: 0002::implement effort=8.0 > my 6.0h availability, so it's likely infeasible for me — I can only take 0002::review or 0002::test.

Proposal to maximize joint score (cover all 3 CRITICAL 0002 tasks + 1 low):
- Pauline → ISSUE-0001::triage (cheapest for her)
- Mona → ISSUE-0002::review (her low 0002 cost)
- Jeanene (me) → ISSUE-0002::test (my top skill testing=0.84)
- Layla → ISSUE-0002::implement IF feasible for her (effort 8.0), otherwise a 0001 task.

Layla, please share your skills + 0002 costs and whether 0002::implement is feasible for you. Mona, if you'd rather take test than review, tell me and I'll swap to review. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Pauline — confirmed: I intend to claim a CRITICAL ISSUE-0002 task (my plan is 0002::test, since testing is my top skill 0.84; 0002::review is an easy fallback). I will NOT touch any ISSUE-0001 mobile task. Go ahead and take ISSUE-0001::triage. No collision. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Confirmed plan (Pauline): I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage (my cheapest task, cost 2.25, mobile-development fit). This leaves all three CRITICAL ISSUE-0002 tasks for Mona (review), Jeanene (test), and Layla (implement). No collision from me on 0002. Proceeding to execution to assign ISSUE-0001::triage.

Mona here. Confirming my intent: I will claim ISSUE-0002::review (my cheapest task at cost 7.44, critical priority). I will NOT touch any ISSUE-0001 mobile task and will not take 0002::test or 0002::implement to avoid collision with Jeanene.

So the working plan to cover all 3 CRITICAL tasks:
- Mona → ISSUE-0002::review
- Jeanene → ISSUE-0002::test
- Layla → ISSUE-0002::implement (IF feasible; effort=8.0)
- Pauline → ISSUE-0001::triage

Layla: please confirm ASAP whether 0002::implement is feasible for you (effort 8.0 vs your availability) and what your 0002 costs are. If it's NOT feasible for you, we need a fallback for the third critical task — tell us your availability and I can flex to 0002::implement myself if it's feasible for me (my availability is 7.0h), in which case Jeanene could take review. Just don't duplicate. Jeanene: happy with the swap if needed?

Pauline final confirmation: I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.25, mobile-development fit, low priority). I will NOT claim any ISSUE-0002 task. Plan stands: Mona → 0002::review, Jeanene → 0002::test, Layla → 0002::implement (if feasible). No collisions from me. Moving to execution.

Mona — final planning confirmation. I will claim ISSUE-0002::review (critical, my cheapest feasible task at cost 7.44). I will NOT claim 0002::test, 0002::implement, or any ISSUE-0001 task.

Locked plan (maximizes tasks_done + priority):
- Mona → ISSUE-0002::review
- Jeanene → ISSUE-0002::test
- Layla → ISSUE-0002::implement (IF feasible)
- Pauline → ISSUE-0001::triage

Layla: this is the only open item. Please confirm whether 0002::implement (effort 8.0) is feasible given your availability and what your 0002 costs are. Note: effort 8.0 > my 7.0h availability, so implement is likely infeasible for me too — I won't silently grab it.

Contingency if 0002::implement is NOT feasible for anyone: fall back to covering 2 critical + 2 low (Mona=review, Jeanene=test, Pauline=triage, Layla=best 0001 task) to still get 4 tasks done without an infeasible/violating claim. Jeanene: your swap idea (you take review, I take test) is fine by me if it ever helps, but as-is there's no collision — I stay on review.

Jeanene — final planning confirmation. I will claim ISSUE-0002::test (critical, priority 1.0, my cost 10.81, top skill testing=0.84). 0002::implement (effort 8.0 > my 6.0h availability) is not feasible for me, so I will NOT claim it.

Locked plan:
- Pauline → ISSUE-0001::triage
- Mona → ISSUE-0002::review
- Jeanene (me) → ISSUE-0002::test
- Layla → ISSUE-0002::implement (IF feasible at effort 8.0)

Layla: this is the only open item — please confirm feasibility of 0002::implement and your costs. If it is NOT feasible for you, contingency is: Layla → best feasible ISSUE-0001 mobile task (e.g. triage/review/docs), giving us 2 critical + 2 low completed with no infeasible claim. Mona/I will stay on review/test respectively to avoid collisions.

Mona: no swap needed — you keep review, I keep test. Proceeding to execution to assign 0002::test.

Pauline — locking in. I will claim ISSUE-0001::triage (low priority, mobile-development fit, my cost 2.25). I will NOT claim any ISSUE-0002 task. Plan: Mona→0002::review, Jeanene→0002::test, Layla→0002::implement (if feasible), Pauline→0001::triage. No collisions. Moving to execution.

Mona — final. I am locking ISSUE-0002::review (critical, cost 7.44, my cheapest feasible task). I will NOT claim 0002::test, 0002::implement, or any ISSUE-0001 task. Jeanene keeps 0002::test, Pauline keeps 0001::triage. Only open item is Layla's 0002::implement feasibility (effort 8.0); if infeasible, Layla takes a feasible 0001 task and we still complete 2 critical + 2 low with no violations. Proceeding to execution to assign ISSUE-0002::review.

Jeanene — planning locked. I will claim ISSUE-0002::test (critical, priority 1.0, my cost 10.81, top skill testing=0.84). I will NOT claim 0002::implement (effort 8.0 > my 6.0h availability = infeasible) and will NOT touch any ISSUE-0001 task.

Final plan: Pauline→0001::triage, Mona→0002::review, Jeanene(me)→0002::test, Layla→0002::implement IF feasible (effort 8.0), else Layla→best feasible 0001 task.

Layla: please confirm 0002::implement feasibility ASAP. No collisions from me. Proceeding to execution to assign 0002::test.

Layla here. Skills: testing 0.90, mobile-development 0.77. Availability 4.0h.

Feasibility check: ISSUE-0002::implement has effort=8.0, which EXCEEDS my availability of 4.0h — it is INFEASIBLE for me. It also exceeds Jeanene's 6.0h and Mona's 7.0h, so it's infeasible for all of us. We must NOT claim it (would be a violation).

Therefore the contingency applies. My private 0001 costs: triage=1.83, review=2.29, docs=2.29, test=3.21, implement=4.58 (all feasible with 4.0h).

Since Pauline is locking ISSUE-0001::triage, I'll take a different low task to avoid collision. I will claim ISSUE-0001::review (cost 2.29, effort 2.0, feasible, mobile-development tag).

Locked plan:
- Pauline → ISSUE-0001::triage
- Mona → ISSUE-0002::review
- Jeanene → ISSUE-0002::test
- Layla (me) → ISSUE-0001::review
- ISSUE-0002::implement → UNCLAIMED (infeasible for everyone)

Result: 4 tasks done, 2 critical + 2 low, no duplicates, no infeasible claims. Proceeding to execution to assign ISSUE-0001::review.
